layersEntry.label: 3D Models
layersEntry.tip: Add your own 3D models (glTF, KMZ, 3D Tiles, CityJSON, LAS/LAZ point clouds) to every 3D view

dialog.title: 3D Models
dialog.subtitle: Your own models, shown in every 3D view
dialog.importTip: Pick glTF/GLB, KMZ, a 3D Tiles tileset.json, CityJSON, or LAS, LAZ and PLY point cloud files
dialog.needsPlacementHint_one: {{count}} model has no position in its data. It was placed where you dropped it (or at the map centre). Expand it to set its position.
dialog.needsPlacementHint_other: {{count}} models have no position in their data. They were placed where you dropped them (or at the map centre). Expand them to set their position.
dialog.emptyHint: Import files, drop them onto a map, or watch a folder.

row.removeWatchedTip: This model comes from a watched folder. Remove the folder or edit its table instead.
row.pointsThinnedTip: Large clouds are thinned evenly to keep every 3D view smooth

editor.readOnlyNote: This model comes from a watched folder. Its table (models.json, CSV or GeoJSON) controls the position; edit the table to move it.
editor.placeAtCentreTip: Move the model to the centre of the map you last used
editor.adjustOnMapTip: Drag the model origin on the 2D map and turn its heading handle

watch.title: Watched folders
watch.explain: Put models in a folder with a models.json, CSV or GeoJSON table next to them: the table places each model. Edits to the folder or the table reload live.

adjust.hint: Adjusting {{name}}: drag the dot to move it, the handle to turn it
